item.title: index
item.description:
Warning Your edit will not be accepted if it doesn't include sufficient Connor and Mitch Branding, such as the Intro. Please check the Branding page. Welcome to the Connor and Mitch editing guide.
Check out Branding and Audio. Ensure you know how to use an editing software. DaVinci Resolve is highly recommended.

item.title: Branding
item.description: Required This is required for all Connor and Mitch videos, regardless of who is editing on that day. At the beginning of every Connor and Mitch video is this intro: Although it has changed over the years, the above intro is the current version as of 2026. The order that the intro happens in is: A funny segment -> EBU Colour Bars from Generators Section with a 1khz Sine Wave Tone -> The above intro clip -> The video itself.Must not be included Credits are only used in official productions, so do not edit in your own credits section. In newer videos, we have a credits section. This is not required and is only used in official productions, so do not edit in your own credits section.
